commissionTerms.unitHint: For each unit sold (piece, kg, l...), excl. VAT.
commissionTerms.goodUnitHint: Empty: the producer's commission. Does not apply to merchants with their own terms.
commissionTerms.lineUnitHint: Commission per unit for a line (from the good). Empty: the order's commission.

auth.forgotIntro: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account uses this email, we sent it a link to set a new password. Check your inbox.
auth.passwordSet: Your password is saved. You can sign in now.

intro.admin: Orders, commissions and everything waiting for you.
intro.producer: Your sales through the platform and the commission on them.
intro.merchant: Your orders and reminders for the next ones.

orders.title: Orders
orders.producerMerchantHint: The merchants you work with. For a new merchant, contact the admin.
orders.merchantRefHint: Optional: the number in the merchant’s own system.
orders.chooseProducer: Choose a producer to see its goods.
orders.priceLockHint: Once a good is in an order, its price for this merchant is locked. Only the admin can change it - ask for a change if needed.
orders.adminPriceHint: Each price defaults to the price excl. VAT from the last order with this merchant, or the producer's price if there is none. A price you change here becomes the merchant's agreed price for the next orders.
orders.noGoods: The producer has no active goods.
orders.notifyHint: The admin and the other party are notified about the new order.
orders.updateAgreed: Keep the new prices as the agreed prices for this merchant
orders.commissionRule: The commission is a percent of the value excl. VAT, or a fixed amount per unit. It is owed in full once the order is delivered, whether or not the merchant has paid the producer, and is due within 5 working days after the delivery.
orders.deliveredHint: A date marks the order delivered.
orders.merchantPaymentsHint: What the merchant paid the producer. Recorded by the producer; it does not change the commission.
orders.commissionPaymentsHint: What the producer paid the intermediary for this order.
orders.returnsHint: Value excl. VAT of returned or credited goods (art. 10). Lowers the commission base.
orders.name: Name
orders.chooseMerchant: Choose a merchant to add goods.
orders.addShopHint: Press "Add shop", pick the shop, then add its goods. One order can cover several shops of the company.
orders.removeShop: Remove this shop and its goods
orders.wantedPriceHint: The producer's current price of the good. For information only.
orders.markCommissionPaidHint: Records the rest of the commission as received today. For a part payment, enter the amount below.

requests.title: Price change requests
requests.intro: Only the admin can change the price of a good in an order. Ask for a change here and see the answer.
requests.adminIntro: Requests from producers and merchants. Approve with a new price, or reject.
requests.onlyAdminHint: The admin will review the request and you will be notified of the decision.
requests.applyOpen: Also change the price in undelivered orders
requests.listPriceHint: When the admin approves, only the good's price changes: agreed prices with merchants and existing orders stay as they are.
requests.listPriceResolveHint: Approving changes only the good's price. Agreed prices with merchants and existing orders do not change.

parties.name: Company name
parties.eikHint: 9 or 13 digits (or a personal number for a sole trader); the check digit is verified.
parties.commissionHint: Empty = the default from the settings (10%). Applies to new orders.
parties.contractHint: The contract runs for 1 year and renews automatically; you will be reminded before the 30-day notice deadline.
parties.activeLabel: Active (can sign in and take part in orders)
parties.zeroVatHint: This merchant's new orders get 0% VAT on every good. Orders already made do not change.

users.title: Platform access
users.hint: The people of this company who sign in. Without a password they get an email link to choose one themselves.
users.adminsHint: Administrators with an email login receive the notifications about new orders and requests.
users.name: Name
users.invited: We sent a password link to {email}.

pairs.title: Attracted merchants (Annex No. 1)
pairs.hint: The producer’s merchants and the special terms for each. An individual commission takes precedence over the standard one (art. 7(3)).
pairs.statusHint: An existing client of the producer (art. 5(4)) or a merchant released for a fee (art. 9) - new orders carry no commission.
pairs.activePeriodHint: The merchant is active with an order within this period (art. 17(3)-(4)). Standard 30.
pairs.releaseFeeHint: Per the contract: 100% of the first deal, min. 500 € → {amount}

goods.title: Goods
goods.producerIntro: Your goods and their prices. A price you change here applies to new merchants; agreed prices stay.
goods.name: Name
goods.lockedNote: This good has an agreed price with {count, plural, one {# merchant} other {# merchants}}. A new price will not change theirs.
goods.archived: The good was ordered before, so it is hidden (archived) instead of deleted.
goods.priceRule: The price in an order is never changed by the producer or the merchant - only by the admin.
goods.priceLockedHint: The good has links with merchants: only the admin can change its price.
goods.askPriceHint: To change the price, send a request to the admin. Agreed prices and existing orders will not change.
goods.pendingPrice: Waiting for the admin to approve the new price {price}.
goods.requestSent: The request was sent to the admin.

prices.title: Agreed prices
prices.hint: The price of each good for each merchant, locked at the first order.
prices.applyOpen: Also change it in undelivered orders
prices.merchantHint: Your agreed price for each good you have ordered. Only the admin changes it; ask for a change if needed.

producerPrices.title: Producer's prices
producerPrices.hint: The prices of the goods: set by the producer, or approved by the admin on the producer's request. New merchants get these; prices agreed with a merchant are on that merchant's page.

trade.contractNote: Indicative: 10% of the turnover with each active merchant (min. 500 €), and 10% of the last 12 months (min. 1000 €) respectively.

producers.title: Producers
producers.merchantIntro: The producers on the platform. Open one to see its goods and your prices.
producers.name: Name
producers.myOrders: {count, plural, =0 {no orders yet} one {# order} other {# orders}}

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.tradeIntro: The merchants that sell your goods, at what price and in what quantity.
merchants.name: Name

shops.title: Shops
shops.hint: The shops of this company, each with its own alias and address. Every order is for one shop.
shops.activeLabel: Active (orders can be placed for it)
shops.none: No shops. Orders go to the merchant's address.

reminders.title: Order reminders
reminders.adminHint: Remind a merchant to place an order by a date. They are notified now (if ticked), N days before and on the day. An order from the merchant closes the reminder.
reminders.merchantHint: Orders you need to place by the given date.
reminders.producerHint: Optional: which producer the order is for.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.intro: What each producer owes you, what you received for each order, and what is coming.
commissions.producerIntro: The commission on your orders: how much has accrued, how much you paid, and the next due date.
commissions.rules: The commission is a percentage of the net delivery value excl. VAT (10% by default; an individual rate takes precedence). It accrues when the merchant pays, in proportion to what was paid, and is due within 5 working days (art. 7-8). Working days take the official Bulgarian holidays into account.
commissions.markPaidHint: Record the rest of this order's commission as received today

request_created.title: Price request #{number}
request_created.body: {good}: {kind, select, list {{producer} asks for a new price of the good} other {{producer} → {merchant}}}, now {current}, proposed {proposed}. {description}

profile.title: Profile
profile.fixedHint: The name, EIK, email and commission are changed by the admin.
profile.producerLogisticsHint: How you deliver and how you send invoices. This is the default for new orders; you can change it in each order.
profile.merchantInvoiceHint: How you receive invoices and how goods are received at your place.
profile.passwordChanged: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultCommissionHint: For new producers without their own rate (10% per the contract).
settings.reminderDays: Remind days before the due date
settings.notifyEmailsHint: Comma-separated. New orders, payments and requests are emailed here (besides administrators with an email login).

errors.invalid_state: Not possible in the current status.
